name: Guess the Emoji
desc:
Join our new community server 👪 to stay up-to-date with our latest updates, giveaways, codes and more🏆💪. Code giveaway on our socials!! 🔥 

Welcome to Guess the Emoji 😄, in this game there are different stages where you try to guess ❓ the right word based on two emojis ✨! Can you guess all the emojis and complete all stages? 🚩

The objective of this game is to complete all stages and reach the end of the game 🏁. At the end of the games are cool tools 🛠️ and gear ⚙️ you can use to play around with. You can also work together and help other players out 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 in the game to complete all stages 🏆.

Make sure to join the group of the game 👥 "Guess The ??" to receive 15% faster hints 💡:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/12601764/Guess-The#!/about
Make sure to play and check out our other guessing games on the group page 🎮. 

Favorite 🌟 and Thumbs Up 👍 the Game to show your support!

scripts.title: Auto Type Answers
scripts.features:
I did not enter a GUI for this, so it is technically open source. I don't plan on making it a loadstring or anything, once executed it'll automatically answer everything (one tps you also) 

It won't crash if you finish. If you rebirth it'll continue, putting wait timer too low will cause it to say "wrong answer" but it won't be the wrong answer
scripts.script:
-- With TP:

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

while wait(0.5) do 
   local lvl = player.Levels.Normal
   local door = workspace.Doors.Normal:FindFirstChild(tonumber(lvl.Value))
   
   if door then
local args = {
    [1] = door.Answers.Answer.Value
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Events.SubmitAnswer:FireServer(unpack(args))
       
    end
    
end
